Tomba Temporal Frame Blending (retired)

This developer-only package is hidden and disabled by default. Its native
callbacks are inert, including when selected by an older state.toml or installed
manifest. Release packages omit it.

The former implementation blended completed images rather than interpolating
game geometry and forced unsynchronized swaps. Tomba retains stock frames until
a replacement is validated. Other presentation mods continue to work.
